title: 6.4 Exponential Functions

icans: I can identify and evaluate exponential functions.
I can graph exponential functions and find their asymptote, domain, and range.
I can tell whether a table or situation is linear or exponential.

vocab: a line a graph gets closer and closer to but never __________
linear: add the same __________ each step; exponential: multiply by the same amount

blocks.p: Plan A: save $10 on day 1, $20 on day 2, $30 on day 3, and so on.   Plan B: save $1 on day 1, $2 on day 2, $4 on day 3, doubling each day.
Plan A: each day I ______________.   Plan B: each day I ______________.
Which plan saves more on day 10? Which would you choose for 4 days?

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Exponential function: An exponential function has the form y = _______________, where a ≠ 0, b > 0, and b ≠ 1.

blocks.stem:
Does each equation represent an exponential function?
a.  y = 4(7)ˣ        b.  y = −6x        c.  y = x³

notes: Linear or exponential tables: Linear tables have a constant _______________. Exponential tables have a constant _______________.

blocks.stem:
Is each table linear or exponential?
a.  x: 0, 1, 2, 3    y: 3, 6, 12, 24
b.  x: 0, 1, 2, 3    y: 1, 4, 7, 10

Evaluate each function.
a.  y = −2(5)ˣ when x = 3        b.  y = 3(½)ˣ when x = −2

notes: Graphs: The graph of y = abˣ + k has an asymptote at _______________. The domain is _______________.

blocks.stem: Graph y = 2ˣ and y = 2ˣ − 3. Find the y-intercept, asymptote, domain, and range of y = 2ˣ − 3.

notes: Exponential situations: A situation is exponential when it changes by the same _______________ each time.

blocks.stem:
Is each situation linear or exponential?
a.  A tank loses 7 gallons of water every hour.
b.  A town’s population grows 3% every year.
For y = 3ˣ + 2, find the y-intercept, asymptote, and range.

tickets.stem: Is y = 5(2)ˣ an exponential function? Explain.
Is the table linear or exponential?   x: 0, 1, 2, 3    y: 2, 6, 18, 54
Give the asymptote and y-intercept of y = 2ˣ − 1.
